mothers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game HUD native source mother for Looper Energy
Primary request: Create one isolated horizontal Energy HUD shell that extends the exact visual family of the three reference HUD assets. It must be a compact rounded wooden game-world object, about 3.2:1 aspect ratio, with the same warm brown rim thickness, softly beveled cream inset, rounded corners, small soft cast shadow, and hand-painted 2.5D material. Include an empty recessed inner vitality channel with no fill and a separate circular inset socket on the left for a future Energy symbol. Keep the silhouette short, plump, friendly, and readable at 44 pt.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; only the isolated HUD object.
Style/medium: cute stylized 2.5D hand-painted game object, clean large shapes, subtle wood grain, restrained detail, production-ready RGBA.
Composition/framing: centered, straight-on, generous transparent margin, no perspective tilt.
Lighting/mood: warm forest daylight, soft top-left light, soft shadow.
Color palette: existing Global HUD warm walnut, cream parchment, muted moss accents only.
Materials/textures: carved wood rim, smooth parchment/ivory inset, subtle natural depth.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no letters, no icons, no fixed data, no annotation, no watermark; preserve Global HUD frame thickness, radius, shadow language and compact scale.
Avoid: orange bar, battery, mana bar, web progress bar, neon, science-fiction HUD, dashboard card, flat vector, proxy, placeholder, metallic instrument, circle gauge, black background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game HUD Energy symbol mother for Looper
Primary request: Create one isolated compact vitality emblem designed to sit inside the circular socket of the reference wooden HUD. The emblem should be a plump rounded amber seed-drop with one tiny fresh green leaf and a softly glowing carved sprout-shaped vein. It should communicate natural vitality without using a lightning bolt or emoji.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; only the isolated emblem.
Style/medium: cute stylized 2.5D hand-painted game object matching the reference HUD materials; clear large forms, minimal detail, crisp alpha, readable at 28–36 px.
Composition/framing: centered, near-front view, square silhouette with generous transparent margin.
Lighting/mood: warm forest light, soft top-left highlight, subtle depth, gentle inner glow.
Color palette: amber honey, warm cream highlight, muted leaf green, tiny walnut shadow.
Materials/textures: polished seed shell, painted wood-like softness, restrained hand-painted grain.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no glyphs, no fixed data, no annotation, no watermark; one emblem only; rounded and friendly, not childish.
Avoid: Unicode lightning, battery icon, coin, medal, star, neon, metallic token, photoreal botanical specimen, flat vector, proxy, placeholder, circular gauge, black background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: four-part production VFX source sheet for Looper Energy HUD
Primary request: Create one clean 2x2 source sheet containing four clearly separated small effect clusters for the reference Energy HUD: top-left Receiving (three soft amber motes and one tiny leaf arc), top-right Full (two small fresh leaves and a gentle warm halo), bottom-left Recovery Tick (one tiny sprout glint with a short upward glow), bottom-right Lv.3 Unlock (a restrained leaf-and-light flourish). Each cluster must remain lightweight and readable at mobile HUD scale.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; the four clusters float separately with wide transparent gutters; no panel and no background.
Style/medium: cute stylized 2.5D hand-painted game VFX, soft-edged, material-aware, restrained.
Composition/framing: exact 2x2 grid, one cluster centered in each quadrant, no overlap.
Lighting/mood: gentle forest warmth, short soft glows, no hard bloom.
Color palette: amber cream, muted moss green, pale leaf green; no saturated orange flood.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no icons, no badges, no arrows, no watermark; small and quiet; production RGBA.
Avoid: particle explosion, magic circle, lightning bolt, coin rain, neon, sci-fi, skill effect, circular UI ring, dashboard indicator, flat vector, black background.
